answer: The chatbot described in arXiv 2505.11946 uses both public and proprietary standards to support AI compliance by integrating these standards into its framework, allowing users to access a comprehensive repository of legal and ethical guidelines. This integration enables the chatbot to assist AI developers and users in evaluating the compliance of their applications with ethical guidelines, legal regulations, and industry standards. By providing tailored guidance based on both public regulations and company-owned standards, the chatbot streamlines the regulatory adherence process, reduces complexity, and fosters responsible AI development. This approach empowers organizations to maintain the recency of their standards and facilitates efficient navigation through hundreds of regulations.
